WHATS ON AT THE CAROUSEL

Upcoming events.

Discover the fantastic events we are fortunate to host.

We look forward to welcoming you into The Carousel.

Regular Events

  • Collage n' Cocktails

    Every other Wednesday
    19:00 - 22:00

    Mix it up with our Collage n’ Cocktails evening. A trunk load of inspiring collage material is the perfect combination for some tasty mock and cocktails.

    Book Here

  • Drink n Draw

    Every other Wednesday
    19:00 - 22:00

    Doodle the night away at our Drink n Draw evening. You will be supplied with prompts, materials and equipment as well as being able to wash it all down with a tasty beverage.

    Book Here

  • Miniatures for Mindfulness

    2nd Tuesday of Month
    19:00 - 22:00
    Monthly Social Miniature Painting Night at The Carousel
    This is a space to paint, sip a nice drink from our cafe/bar, and spend time with others who love miniatures - no pressure, no competition, just chats and creativity.

    Book Here

  • Wednesday Regular

    Become a Carousel Regular

    Our Wednesday Regular membership allows you to come to all our Wednesday Workshops for £15 per month as well as getting members prices on drinks and snacks. Your contribution also supports our workshops, courses, events and exhibitions.

    Join Us Here

  • Art Therapy Book Club

    First Tuesday of the Month
    19:00 - 21:00

    Give Yourself Permission to Rest, Create, and Just Be.

    Welcome to our Art Therapy Book Club—a sanctuary for those wanting to take a take a break from our busy world and reflect on our lives, the world we live in, and the world we want it to be.

    This is a unique hybrid of a book club and a space for using art therapeutically. This book club is intentionally slow and we may be reading the same book for many sessions. Together, we’ll explore powerful books that make us think about our lives, support wellbeing, or make us reflect, and use art to process our discussions, and share our journeys in a supportive community. No art experience needed—just an open heart.

    Book Here

  • Carousel Drop in Art Café

    Saturdays in September, October and November
    11:00am - 2:00pm
    A place to meet people and create, with new activities and themes weekly

    Click Here

21

The Hop-nights - Day 2

  • Saturday 21 March 2026
  • 19:00 23:00
  • Google Calendar ICS

Roll up... roll up! It's time for The Hop-nights 2026... A weekend of ska, reggae & rocksteady music in Nottingham hosted by The Hoplites.

3 days of music, 3 different line-ups, 3 different headline sets from The Hoplites.

Tickets are £12 per day or you can purchase a 3 day ticket for £26.

The Sunday show is an all ages matinee - so why not bring the whole family!

The Hoplites bring a high-energy live show with an arsenal of percussion, guitars, and a full horn section. Their vibrant set of all-original tunes channels the spirit of first-wave Jamaican ska, aiming to bring that authentic sound back to festival stages across the UK.

Although a relatively new project, the band features veterans of the Nottingham music scene and have already played major UK festival stages, supporting the likes of Sonic Boom Six, Jeremiah Ferrari, and The Beat. The Hoplites' shows are guaranteed to get any crowd skanking.

Mar
13

bUTTONpUSHER PRESENTS….. NI (France) | A-tota-so

  • Friday 13 March 2026
  • 19:00 23:00
  • Google Calendar ICS

NI (France)

Four-headed monster,
the big bad Ni has left the linear roads of France
in order to live in a complex world paced
by electrical sounds and varying polyrhythms.

In its temple, shouts of the quartet make the windows crack,
a stunning nervousness makes the walls stand and, finally,
the strong foundations remove from ages to come all doubts
regarding the durability of all these things.

Inside, it is always like a squall:
children run in all directions and parents dance around the bonfire.
The waltz, the 4/4 time signature and verse and chorus structures
take one last breath before being burned to ashes at the core of this fire.

Willow Bay 'Evangeline' EP Launch

  • Saturday 28 February 2026
  • 19:00 23:00
  • Google Calendar ICS

Willow Bay are a 3-piece indie-folk trio from Nottingham and Derbyshire, UK. The band comprises of Aaliyah, Matt & Ben who came together around a shared passion for delicate, melodic songwriting and rich instrumentation.

Since forming, the band have released a series of singles that have garnered support from BBC Introducing, LeftLion and Y Not Festival, while resonating with music lovers and fellow artists across the UK and beyond.

Their 'Evangeline' E.P is the culmination of the bands first year together and forms the backbone of their current live set.

This show will see a special line up with additional musicians performing with the trio, alongside some incredible support acts to be announced.

Come and celebrate the first chapter of Willow Bay.

Learn to Love Riso with Pink Menace

  • Wednesday 18 February 2026
  • 19:00 21:00
  • Google Calendar ICS

Learn to love risoprinting! Suitable for beginners

A guided introduction to risoprinting!

Risoprinting is an eco-friendly cross between photocopying and screen printing, using soy-based inks to create beautiful overlapping images with unique textures.

Learn how to create and print your own designs - come away with ten copies. Perfect for valentines cards (for your loved one or the whole polycule), galentines cards for the girls and the guys, lunar new years celebration, or anything you're feeling like creating!
